newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Congress approves Labor Law reform bill.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Congress approves Labor Law reform bill.

text.p: Venezuela's Congress gave its final approval Tuesday to the country's crucial Labor Law reform bill, legislators said.

The bill, which now only needs the formality of President Rafael Caldera's signature to become law, paves the way for a revamping of Venezuela's decaying social security system as well as the liberalization of the country's rigid labor markets.

"Approved," said the president of Congress's lower house, Ramon Guillermo Aveledo, bringing to a successful close over 10 years of repeated attempts to reform the outdated social security and severance pay system. The impasse was only broken in mid-March in Tripartite talks between the governemnt, unions and private sector leaders.

Congress's lower house of Deputies gave final approval after the Senate passed the bill last week. More legislatation is required to round-off the social security reform package, including laws governing a proposed system of fully funded pension funds, as well as unemployment and health insurance.
